preview.//ios: Ad-hoc distribution needs registered device UDIDs. Until an Apple Developer account exists, build the simulator target instead — it needs no signing and still proves the native project compiles.

production.//ios: Apple requires apps be built with the iOS 18 SDK (Xcode 16+) since 2025-04-24; EAS defaults to Xcode 16 for SDK 52+, so no image pin is needed. A store build needs a paid Apple Developer account, a distribution certificate and a provisioning profile — none of which exist yet.

android.//: The CANONICAL Play artifact is this React Native app. The TWA in apps/android shares the package name com.furlpay.app and must never be submitted — see apps/android/DEPRECATED.md.

ios.//: BLOCKED ON AN APPLE DEVELOPER ACCOUNT. ascAppId, appleTeamId and either an App Store Connect API key or an Apple ID must be supplied before `eas submit -p ios` can run. They are deliberately absent rather than filled with placeholders: a wrong ascAppId submits this binary to somebody else's app record.
ios.//credentials: eas credentials -p ios   — then set ascAppId and appleTeamId here.
